entities.summary: "'Cuz I Can" is a song by American singer Pink from her fourth studio album, I'm Not Dead (2006). It was written by Pink, Max Martin and Lukasz Gottwald, and produced by Martin. One of the five tracks from I'm Not Dead to prematurely leak onto the Internet in July 2005, the song was ultimately released as a promotional single in select countries on October 4, 2007, by LaFace Records.
